hooks.command: [ -x node_modules/.bin/prettier ] || exit 0; f=$(git diff --name-only --diff-filter=AM | grep -E '\.(ts|tsx|css|md|json)$'); [ -z "$f" ] || node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --log-level warn $f 2>/dev/null || true
grep -q '"check:tokens"' package.json 2>/dev/null || exit 0; npm run -s check:tokens 1>&2 || exit 2
